summary: The operator deploys standalone Redis by default; for clustered Redis set redis_mode to cluster (Advanced configuration > Redis Mode) when creating a new instance, which gives 6 Redis replicas; switching mode on an existing instance isn't supported.
questions: How do I deploy clustered Redis with the AAP Operator?
Can I change redis_mode on an existing AAP instance?
How many Redis replicas does cluster mode create?

answer_card.title: Clustered Redis on OpenShift
answer_card.answer_md: On a **new** instance set `redis_mode: cluster` (Advanced configuration > *Redis Mode* > Cluster). It deploys 6 Redis replicas. Changing the mode on an existing instance is unsupported and can lose data: deploy a new instance instead.
